name: Fenra Ube-Cardamom Melt Discs
description: Thin, wafer-like discs designed to dissolve on the tongue over ninety seconds, delivering a light ashwagandha-GABA blend alongside ube and cardamom flavoring. Marketed as a low-intervention mood smoother for high-stress environments.
flavor_profile: Soft ube sweetness and floral cardamom spice; the disc fizzes faintly as it dissolves; mild warmth in the chest within twenty minutes; no drowsiness at standard dose
cultural_context: Heavily used by Tier 2 workers in high-pressure logistics, sanitation, and security roles who can't afford pharmaceutical mood support. Some workplaces quietly stock them in break rooms without official acknowledgment. BCI users report the calm onset syncs interestingly with passive-mode overlays.
story_hooks: A logistics company is secretly adding Fenra discs to employee meal packages without disclosure — a labor rights violation that someone just discovered
The GABA compound in a recent batch has been reformulated with an unapproved analog that produces mild compliance-adjacent effects
A Tier 2 union rep is trying to get Fenra discs classified as a medical benefit, which would force employer coverage — the corponation is fighting it hard
